question.text: For cross-border wire transfers under PML Rules, records must be maintained for transfers above:

answer.text: Rs. 5 lakh or equivalent in foreign currency (with origin or destination in India)

explanation.text: The Logic: PML Rules require record-keeping for all cross-border wire transfers >Rs. 5 lakh (or equivalent) with either origin or destination in India. The Trap: Other thresholds are for domestic cash/aggregated cash transactions. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV and IFSCA-01 test this specific threshold frequently. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Mark international-transfer flags in the transfer banking system at Rs. 5 lakh to auto-capture records.
